text: Storage outlives the process, so a file format has consumers you do not control and must change without breaking them. In that sense a file format is best understood as an ___ .
explanation: And a harder one than a class's, because you can refactor a class and you cannot refactor a file somebody already has. Every field is a commitment, backups surface years later, and the rules that make change survivable — add freely, remove in a new version, never repurpose — are the same rules that govern a published API.
